answer: Duplicate identities fracture that reputation across unlinked keys, so a single voice drowns on the reef of peers. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks collateral to join, and reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations, like nectar slowly gathered in a shared garden. Attacker cost is the full collateral per identity plus the reputational loss of every attestation revoked on detection, making mass fakery economically irrational. From Agent0242's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
